title: Donald Trump Recounts Pilots' 'Very Strange' UFO Stories, But Says He's 'Not Too Much Of A Believer'
description: US President Donald Trump said Air Force pilots had told him about unexplained objects flying at extraordinary speeds, including a round object reportedly travelling three times faster than an F-22 fighter jet. Speaking on CBS' 60 Minutes, Trump said he remained sceptical about UFOs and was unaware of any secret government programme investigating them.
